provenance.report: plan step 5 follow-up: what makes the router answer SUBSCRIBE with a NOTIFY of every row (work/2026-11-jg-descriptors/winbox4/first-notify.ts), 2026-11-22
provenance.steps: defaults = GETALL 0xfe000c=0x20000000 0xfe0004=0; policies = GETPOLICIES; getall = GETALL with the word; sub / unsub = SUBSCRIBE / UNSUBSCRIBE with the word ([16,2] 0x10000007, [20,0] 0x1004000f); sub0 = SUBSCRIBE without a word. Modifiers: nr = no SYS_REPLYEXP / SYS_REQID; 17 = 0xff0017=true; 12 = 0xff0012=1000 (u32). from own = FROM [0, source id + 40] instead of the adopted id.
provenance.sessions: each variant and path is its own SRP login (session = mark); listen 600 ms after each step
provenance.lab_rows: bridge m2ir-br with one port (m2ir-vl1, comment m2ir-r3) left from the step 5 recovery run
provenance.note: Sanitized M2 hex plus decoded entries only: no hosts, ports, credentials or wall-clock time (tMs is ms since the probe started). The plaintext starts after the SRP login.
